exposure: expectant management of PPROM until 37 weeks
immediate delivery for PPROM at 34 weeks
cohort: A theoretical cohort of 37,455 women with PPROM at 34 weeks.
finding: Expectant management of PPROM at 34 weeks was associated with fewer neonatal deaths and cases of neurodevelopmental delay but more cases of neonatal and maternal sepsis, and was more cost-effective than immediate delivery.
